reported.title: Wrong serial format for Temp line
reported.description: Prints `temp=<value>` instead of the required `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon, so the serial output does not match the specified format.

reported.title: Freeze captures live value instead of last sample
reported.description: While D5 is held LOW, frozenC is continuously overwritten with the current reading, so the value is not frozen at the last sample before the button was pressed; it keeps tracking the probe.

reported.title: ADC scaling uses 1023 instead of 1024
reported.description: volts = raw*(5/1023) introduces a small scale error; the correct full-scale divisor for the ATmega328P ADC is 1024, which keeps the reading within the ±1.5 °C tolerance.

reported.title: Sample counter increments every loop, not per second
reported.description: samples++ runs on every loop iteration rather than once per print period, so `weather n=` reports a rapidly growing loop count instead of the number of samples taken each second.

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^Temp: ' every 1000 ms (Temp: lines)
serial values for 'Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 1.5) (Value OK)

judge_input.spec:
- TMP36 on A0 (10 mV/°C with 500 mV offset); freeze button on D5 (pull-up); range lamp on D7.
- Every 1000 ms print exactly `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon and one decimal place.
- Printed temperature must stay within ±1.5 °C of the injected probe value.
- While D5 is held LOW, freeze the reported value at the last sample.
- Light D7 when the reported temperature is outside -10.0 to 50.0 °C.
- Also print `weather n=<samples>` each second after the Temp line.
